# CodePipelineVfsMode

Whether a code pipeline's agents can change a mounted file system.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"ReadOnly"` | The agents can read the file system but not change it. |
| `"ReadWrite"` | The agents can read and change the file system. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CodePipelineProcessVfsMount`](code-pipeline-process-vfs-mount.md)
- Inside [`CodePipelineVfsBinding`](code-pipeline-vfs-binding.md)
